free_tier.stated: Kansas City: Storage 1 2,560 GB / Storage 2 5,120 GB / Storage 3 10,240 GB / Storage 4 20,480 GB, each as 20 GB NVMe boot + HDD, 10 Gbps.

egress.terms: Bundled bandwidth without published overage schedule: 8 TB, 16 TB, 32 TB, and 48 TB per month across tiers. The 20 TB tier provides 48 TB of transfer.

tooling: rclone SFTP, documented JSON control API (console.advinservers.com/api/v1)
chaining: A 10 Gbps network port paired with a 20 TB single virtual machine allows hosting a 20 TB archive on a single instance without sharding.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none. Every storage rung showed sold out on stackrates' October 2026 snapshot and the store page 404s on the direct product URL. The provider has publicly floated '$2.50/TB of HDD, on a monthly commitment' as an ambition (LET 203516 p3).
reliability_note: Delaware-based provider with approximately 30 nodes in US and EU, 99.9% SLA, 14-day money-back guarantee, and owned hardware. Hardware stock is frequently limited with zero availability across standard tiers.
